CustomField.label: Primary Contact
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Highest-priority linked contact: Property Owner, then Property Manager, Leasing, HOA, Broker, Developer; oldest link wins ties. Maintained from Opportunity_Contact__c. See Contact Count for the total.
CustomField.description: Denormalised "who do I call" contact so Opportunity reports can show one row per property. Salesforce cannot concatenate child text into a parent formula, hence this lookup.
